name: Grade every instrumentation check for this project.
description: Grade every instrumentation check for this project. GET /api/projects/{project_id}/ai_observability/instrumentation_checklist/
context:
GET /api/projects/{project_id}/ai_observability/instrumentation_checklist/
Grade every instrumentation check for this project.
Required: project_id (path) — Project ID of the project you're trying to access. To find the ID of the project, make a call to /api/projects/.
Optional: refresh (query) — Grade the checks against a fresh read instead of a recent cached one. Use it after changing instrumentation, when a cached verdict would still describe the old code.
